text:
Maya: Quick weekly health check for Halo (onboarding). High-level: tokens have plateaued this week after their feature launch. WoW tokens -8%, QoQ +12%. Median throughput ~120 req/s. 95p latency ~420ms. Error rate 0.9% (was 0.3% last week). Adding notes and graphs below.

Jared: Saw the same. There's a repeat daily spike around 10:42 UTC where requests fall back to the smaller model — that's when latency and errors spike. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.com/d/halo/overview?range=7d :eyes:

Liam: I pulled traces. Fallback is triggered by our latency SLO policy when 95p > 500ms. That threshold hit because of a burst of long-context completions after the new prompt template. Snippet from tracer:```
2026-03-15T10:42:13Z ERROR model-router fallback model=redwood-small reason=kv-cache-miss seq=1542
2026-03-15T10:42:13Z WARN  request-id=abc123 latency=612ms
```

Nora (Halo): Confirmed — we shipped a guided flow Tue AM which increased long-session completions. We're seeing the burst from a campaign. We're more concerned about spend than the occasional latency bump. Any quick wins to lower cost without degrading UX? :raising_hand:

Jared: Quick wins: 1) prefix caching for repeated system prompts, 2) reduce max_tokens in less-critical paths, 3) route low-priority background jobs to cheaper model variant. I'll draft a one-page playbook.

Liam: Also recommend a short canary: 10% traffic on quantized int8 variant and observe quality/latency. Batching window can be tightened to 30ms for this workload to reduce per-token cost but watch tail latency.

Sana: Action items captured: 1) Maya schedule enablement + cost-playbook review with Halo this Thu 2pm PT (Maya) 2) Jared write cost playbook + sample configs (due Wed EOD) 3) Liam open infra ticket to lower fallback sensitivity + enable canary (ticket ENG-5421) 4) Henry add renewal-risk note if spend > forecast after playbook. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Halo spend (7d): $4,800 (↑22% WoW). Forecast for month is $16k. Link: https://billing.redwood.com/accounts/halo

Jared: Sample config I'll attach in the playbook to throttle tokens and reduce burst spending:```
rate_limit:
  per_minute: 1200
prompt_policy:
  max_tokens: 512
  truncate_tail: true
cache:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

Maya: Booking invite + agenda sent to Nora. I'll include a small set of dashboards (token trend, 95p latency, error map) and proposed config changes. If error rate climbs >1.5% after changes we escalate to infra.

Henry: I'll fold this into the weekly account health deck. Note for renewals — QoQ trend is positive but WoW dip and spend spike raise a medium risk flag until enablement and playbook land.

Nora (Halo): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll prep a short session recording and share sample traffic patterns before Thu.

Maya: Thanks. We'll reconvene after the enablement call and update this thread with results. :thumbsup:
